name: GOVERNANCE
gates: VERIFICATION GATE - Present-tense security, privacy, governance, resilience, compliance, deployment, or AI-control claims must match implemented and verified capability/status.
meta_description: As LAMID ONE becomes more capable and more continuous, governance must make progression, permission, authority, override, and accountability clearer.
title: Capability Needs Accountability.
description: As LAMID ONE becomes more capable and more continuous, governance must make progression, permission, authority, override, and accountability clearer - without making everyday use harder to understand.

paragraphs.text: As LAMID ONE becomes more capable and more continuous, governance must make progression, permission, authority, override, and accountability clearer - without making everyday use harder to understand.
Keep clarity, progressive disclosure, guidance, pacing, and audience coherence consistent as the experience adapts.
Control roles, permissions, delegation, workflows, approvals, override rights, revocation, and accountability inside organizations.

Define which sources and workflows may progress in the background, how permission, freshness, provenance, and prior state are shown, when users are notified, what can be overridden or reversed, what requires approval, and how material progression is audited.
Keep experience, product, organizational, platform, and AI governance coordinated while preserving clear responsibilities.
